newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MAURICE SET TO RETURN AFTER SIX-MONTH LAYOFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAURICE SET TO RETURN AFTER SIX-MONTH LAYOFF.

text.p: Lyon's French international striker Florian Maurice could make his much awaited first division comeback at home to Guingamp on Saturday.
Maurice ruptured his Achilles tendon playing at Nantes in September, three days after winning his first cap as a substitute against Mexico.
The striker has been included in Lyon's squad of 16 for the mid-table match.
